notes.title: RELEASE: 4K OUTLAW EDITION
notes.notes:
[h2]Lend me your ears, folks—got ourselves some mighty important news comin’ down the trail![/h2]

Thanks to some dark voodoo magic (and a few well-placed gunshots), we’ve cranked this here game up to [b]4K resolution[/b]. What does that mean? Four times the detail, razor-sharp visuals, and an atmosphere so thick with Wild West grit, you can almost taste the dust.

But we ain’t stopped there, partner. We’ve smoothed out the animations in the ol’ roll-in-the-hay scenes, brought characters to life with new dialogue animations, and tuned up the code so the whole experience runs slicker than a well-oiled six-shooter.

So saddle up and feast your eye – this is one ride you gotta see to believe. Yeehaw!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2198000/Curt_Maddox/

notes.title: 4K OUTLAW EDITION on the horizon
notes.notes:
[h1]Howdy cowboys![/h1]
Today we got an important announcement for all CURT MADDOX fans - 4K OUTLAW EDITIONS is seen on the horizon!

[b]What we have done?[/b]

[list]
[*] upscaled all static images and animation frames into might 3940 × 2160 px resolution
[*] added animated character portraits for the dialogs
[*] make in-game economy easier
[*] improved the performance.
[/list]

All those changes with keeping the file size almost the same! 
[b]True voodoo magic mixed with gunpowder.[/b]

[h3]CURT MADDOX 4K OUTLAW EDITION will be released by the end of this month.[/h3]

notes.title: Work in progress - adding more content
notes.notes:
We're adding more content to the STEAM version of our game. That's great news cause when you receive CURT MADDOX on STEAM you'll also get WIDER HORIZONS expansion at the same price.

With the expansion, you'll get access to the new scenes oriented around two new girls.

The first of them is an independent woman who knows exactly how to deliver pleasure or pain. Life gave her a lesson about achieving her goals by any necessary means. She is ruthless, dangerous, and adorable at the same time. Do you believe she could fool Curt and make him her errand boy for the price of some kisses and innocent teasing? So far, we have 90% of the renders with CANDELA, and we’re now working on the script.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162448/dab6223f235baf1b1963e4cc4a772a3ba66ce9d4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162448/ef7fb647c29f4f200007f2cbc7d2db1a142cbc6c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162448/51dc08eda129e31b39a27324e5f3b1a9225dfd27.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162448/443a7a3760f9dcb04c8bd597eade6a537f03f33f.jpg[/img]

FENG is a different story. She is much more feminine, sensual and innocent. Looking for love in the wild west isn’t an easy task, but FENG is determined to find love and CURT is there to help her achieve that romantic goal. He will work as a matchmaker for her, and with the help of his friends, he will prepare the chosen one for a perfect date with Asian beauty. I estimate that currently, we have done around 20% of renders with FENG.
